summary: Full-extraction pass over the ten Australian Migration Program reports (2014-15 to 2024-25, no 2016-17), the 2023 Review of the Migration System and the LIN 21/041 explanatory statement. Added every BIIP number the reports print: comparison tables (lodgements, outcome, on hand, grant/refusal/withdrawal rates for every printed year), outcome by state of intended residence, by client location and by BIIP stream, Skill-stream shares and year-on-year changes, plus the review's BIIP charts (Census 2016 participation, education, employment, income; fiscal impact; previous visa) and the 2021 complying-investment rules. All state, stream and location splits add up to the printed totals (masked cells within range).

events.title: Complying investment instrument amended (LIN 21/041)
events.description: Migration (Complying Investments) Amendment Instrument (LIN 21/041) 2021 commences on 1 July 2021 (registered 30 June 2021). For applicants invited after 30 June 2021 it replaces absolute amounts with minimum shares (at least 20% venture capital, at least 30% emerging companies, the rest in those or balancing investments), cuts the time to sign venture capital fund agreements from 12 to 6 months, requires annual audits of emerging-companies and balancing funds from 2021-22, tightens rules on derivatives and exchange traded funds, and allows venture capital through fund-of-funds structures.
events.quote: The instrument commences on the later of: (a) 1 July 2021; and (b) the day after registration on the Federal Register of Legislation.

events.title: Investor stream moved to complying significant investments; minimum raised to $2.5 million
events.description: From 1 July 2021 the Investor stream requirement changes from a passive designated investment in state and territory government securities to a complying significant investment, and the minimum rises from $1.5 million to $2.5 million (bare "$" in the document).
events.quote: The amended Regulations will change the current designated investment requirement for the Investor stream (based on passive investment in State and Territory government security) to a requirement to make a complying significant investment
